start.description: Window start (Unix seconds). Only echoed by `/schedule/preview`; omitted elsewhere.

end.description: Window end (Unix seconds). Only echoed by `/schedule/preview`; omitted elsewhere.

notify.description: Shift notification configuration; `null` when the schedule has none.

schedule_id.description: Schedule ID. Null when returned from `/schedule/preview`.

schedule_name.description: Schedule display name. null when returned from /schedule/preview.

team_id.description: Owning team ID. null when returned from /schedule/preview.

description.description: Schedule description. null when returned from /schedule/preview.

layer_schedules.description: Same content as `schedule_layers`, filled by `/schedule/info` and `/schedule/preview` only; `null` elsewhere.

status.description: Mirror of `disabled`: `0` = enabled, `1` = disabled. Send it on `/schedule/update` to enable or disable a schedule. `null` in `/schedule/preview` unless sent.

cur_oncall.description: The shift in progress now; `null` when nobody is on call, or when the endpoint does not compute it (`/schedule/infos`, `/schedule/self`, `/schedule/list` without a window).

next_oncall.description: The next shift with someone on duty after the current one; `null` when none is found within 45 days or the endpoint does not compute it.

ScheduleLayer.description: One layer of a schedule. A rotation layer (`mode` 0) cycles through `groups`; an override layer (`mode` 1) puts its first group on call from `layer_start` to `layer_end`. Response-only fields (`account_id`, `schedule_id`, `create_*`, `update_*`) are ignored in requests.

account_id.description: ID of the account that owns the layer. Set by the server.

name.description: Layer name. Either `name` or `layer_name` is required; `layer_name` wins when both are set.

schedule_id.description: ID of the schedule the layer belongs to. Set by the server.

hidden.description: `1` leaves the layer out of `schedule_layers`; its shifts still feed `final_schedule`. `0` (default) shows it.

mode.description:
Layer type:
- `0`: rotation layer — groups take turns according to `rotation_unit`/`rotation_value`.
- `1`: override layer — the first group in `groups` is on call for the whole `layer_start`–`layer_end` period and takes precedence over rotation layers.

weight.description: Stored as sent; not used when computing shifts.

groups.description: On-call groups of the layer, in rotation order. Each group needs `group_name` (or `name`) and members with at least one person. `start`/`end` are ignored on input.

rotation_duration.description: Rotation length in seconds. Legacy alternative to `rotation_unit` + `rotation_value`: when only this is set, the server derives them (whole weeks, days or hours), and when only those are set, it fills this in (a month counts as 30 days).

handoff_time.description: Weekly handoff point for weekly rotations, as seconds from Monday 00:00 in the schedule's time zone (`weekday × 86400 + seconds of day`, Monday = 0 … Sunday = 6). Not a Unix timestamp. Easier to set with `handoff`.

enable_time.description: When the layer takes effect (Unix seconds). For rotations its time of day is also the daily handoff time. `layer_start` overrides it when sent.

expire_time.description: When the layer stops (Unix seconds); `0` = never. Must not be earlier than `enable_time`. `layer_end` overrides it when sent.

restrict_mode.description:
Restricts the layer to time windows given in `restrict_periods`:
- `0`: no restriction.
- `1`: daily windows; offsets are seconds from 00:00 (0–86400).
- `2`: weekly windows; offsets are seconds from Monday 00:00 (0–604800). Cannot be combined with `day_mask`.
Windows use the schedule's time zone.

restrict_start.description: Legacy single-window start offset in seconds; prefer `restrict_periods`.

restrict_end.description: Legacy single-window end offset in seconds; prefer `restrict_periods`.

restrict_periods.description: Time windows in which the layer is on call, interpreted by `restrict_mode`. Outside them the layer has nobody on call. `null` when not set.

day_mask.description: Weekdays on which the rotation layer is on call.

layer_name.description: Layer name shown in the console; same value as `name` in responses.

fair_rotation.description: When `true`, the group that starts each full round shifts by one, so that no group is always first. `false` (default) always restarts from the first group.

layer_start.description: Same as `enable_time`; takes precedence over it in requests. `null` when `enable_time` is 0.

layer_end.description: Same as `expire_time`; takes precedence over it in requests. `null` means the layer never ends.

rotation_unit.description:
Rotation unit. On-call assignees rotate in turn by this unit.
| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `hour` | Rotates hourly. |
| `day` | Rotates daily. |
| `week` | Rotates weekly. |
| `month` | Rotates monthly. |

rotation_value.description: Number of `rotation_unit`s each group stays on call before handing off. A rotation layer needs either this (with `rotation_unit`) or `rotation_duration`.

mask_continuous_enabled.description: Only applies when `day_mask` selects 1–6 weekdays. When `true`, each on-call day runs from the layer's start time of day to the same time the next day instead of midnight to midnight.

starts_at.description: Request only. Layer start as a wall-clock date and time in the schedule's time zone; overrides `layer_start`/`enable_time`.

ends_at.description: Request only. Layer end as a wall-clock date and time in the schedule's time zone; overrides `layer_end`/`expire_time`. Send `{"date": ""}` to make the layer never end.

handoff.description: Request only. Handoff weekday and time in the schedule's time zone; sets `handoff_time` and the time of day of `enable_time`.

restricts_wall.description: Request only. Restriction windows as wall-clock times in the schedule's time zone; replaces `restrict_periods`. With `restrict_mode` 1 use `from`/`to` (`to` = `00:00` means end of day); with `restrict_mode` 2 also set `from_day`/`to_day`. Rejected when `restrict_mode` is 0.

from_day.description: ISO weekday the window starts on (`restrict_mode` 2 only): `1` = Monday … `7` = Sunday.

to_day.description: ISO weekday the window ends on (`restrict_mode` 2 only).

ScheduleListRequest.description: Schedule list filters. `limit` defaults to 10 and is capped at 100; `p` defaults to 1. `is_my_team` and `is_my_manage` cannot both be true.

query.description: Substring matched against the schedule name or description.

limit.description: Page size. Default 10; values above 100 are treated as 100.

is_my_team.description: Only schedules owned by the caller's teams. When `team_ids` shares no team with the caller, or the caller belongs to no team, the list is empty.

is_my_manage.description: Only schedules owned by the caller's teams or created by the caller. `team_ids` narrows the team part; team IDs outside the caller's teams are ignored.

team_ids.description: Only schedules owned by these teams. With `is_my_team` or `is_my_manage`, only the teams the caller belongs to are kept.

start.description: Window start, 10-digit Unix seconds. Send together with `end` to compute layers and shifts.

end.description: Window end, 10-digit Unix seconds, after `start` and at most 45 days later. Sending `end` without `start` is rejected.

items.description: Schedules on this page; an empty array when none match.

total.description: Total number of schedules matching the filters.

role_id.description: On-call role assigned to the people in this slot; `0` = no role.

person_ids.description: Member IDs in this slot; at least one.

ScheduleNotify.description: Notification configuration attached to a schedule.

advance_in_time.description: Lead time in seconds for the shift-change notification: `0` notifies at the start of the shift, `300` five minutes before. Omitted or `null` disables shift-change notifications.

fixed_time.description: Send a shift summary at a fixed time; `null` when not configured.

by.description: Personal notifications sent to the people on call; `null` when not configured.

im.description: Legacy map of robot type to webhook token. Entries not already in `webhooks` are added to `webhooks` when read; use `webhooks` instead.

webhooks.description: Group chats or robots that receive shift-change notifications; `null` when not configured.

follow_preference.description: `true`: notify each person through the channels in their own shift-notification preference, ignoring `personal_channels`. `false`: use `personal_channels`.

personal_channels.description: Channels used when `follow_preference` is `false`: `email`, `sms`, `push` (mobile app), and the IM apps `feishu_app`, `dingtalk_app`, `wecom_app`, `teams_app`, `slack_app`. An IM app value may carry the integration ID as `<type>:<integration ID>` (for example `feishu_app:5427276014131`). Unknown values are stored but never used. `null` when not set.

ScheduleOncallGroup.description: Snapshot of the currently or next on-call group.

group.description: Oncall group on duty for the shift.

update_at.description: Update time as a Unix timestamp in seconds; always `0` in these responses.

ScheduleRestrictPeriod.description: One on-call window inside a day or week (see `restrict_mode`). A window whose start is later than its end wraps past midnight (or the end of the week). `{0, 0}` means the whole day or week. Start and end may not be equal otherwise.

restrict_start.description: Window start in seconds: from 00:00 when `restrict_mode` is 1, from Monday 00:00 when it is 2.

restrict_end.description: Window end in seconds, same reference point as `restrict_start`.

ScheduleSelfRequest.description: Query parameters for listing the current user's schedules. start and end are required 10-digit Unix timestamps in seconds, and the window must not exceed 45 days.

end.description: Window end (Unix seconds, 10 digits). Required. Must be within 45 days of start.

items.description: Matching schedules; an empty array when none match.

ScheduleUpsertRequest.description: Request body of `/schedule/create`, `/schedule/update` and `/schedule/preview`. `schedule_name` (or the legacy `name`) is required on create, `schedule_id` on update, and `start`/`end` on preview.

schedule_id.description: Schedule ID, required on update; obtain it from `POST /schedule/list`.

schedule_name.description: Schedule name, at most 40 characters, unique within the account. On update, omitting it keeps the current name.

name.description: Legacy name field, used on create only when `schedule_name` is empty. Ignored on update.

description.description: Schedule description, at most 500 characters. On update, omitting it keeps the current text and an empty string clears it.

team_id.description: ID of the owning team; obtain it from `POST /team/list`. On create, omitting it leaves the schedule without a team (`0`); on update, omitting it keeps the current team.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone in which the schedule's wall-clock rules are evaluated, for example `Asia/Shanghai` or `UTC`; abbreviations such as `EST` and `Etc/GMT±N` are rejected. Set on create (default: evaluated in `Asia/Shanghai`); immutable afterwards — on update send nothing or the current value. On preview it sets the evaluation time zone.

layers.description: Rotation layers. Required in practice: on update the list replaces all existing layers, so omitting it deletes every layer.

notify.description: Shift notification configuration. On update, omitting it keeps the current configuration; a sent object replaces it entirely.

start.description: Preview window start, 10-digit Unix seconds. Required for `/schedule/preview`; ignored by create and update.

end.description: Preview window end, 10-digit Unix seconds, after `start` and at most 45 days later. Required for `/schedule/preview`; ignored by create and update.

disabled.description: Create only: `0` = enabled (default), `1` = disabled. Ignored on update — use `status` instead.

status.description: `0` = enabled, `1` = disabled. On update, omitting it keeps the current state. On create it takes precedence over `disabled`.

ServiceDeskPlusRequestListRequest.description: Filters for listing ServiceDeskPlus request synchronization records. A time window is optional when querying by incident ID; otherwise provide a Unix-second window no longer than 30 days.

start_time.description: Window start, Unix seconds. Optional when `incident_id` is provided.

end_time.description: Window end, Unix seconds. Must be greater than or equal to `start_time`. Optional when `incident_id` is provided.

status.description: Filter by sync status: `success` or `failed`.

integration_id.description: ServiceDeskPlus integration ID.

incident_id.description: Flashduty incident ID. When set, the time window can be omitted.

asc.description: When `true`, sort by internal record ID ascending; otherwise descending.

p.description: Not supported; pagination uses only `search_after_ctx`, so this value is ignored.

limit.description: Page size. Defaults to 20; maximum 100.

search_after_ctx.description: Pagination cursor: leave empty for the first page, then pass the `search_after_ctx` returned by the previous response.

ServiceDeskPlusRequestListResponse.description: Paginated list of ServiceDeskPlus request synchronization records.

has_next_page.description: True when more results are available.

items.description: Synchronization records on the current page.

search_after_ctx.description: Cursor for the next page. Empty when no more data is available.

total.description: Total number of matching records, capped at 1,000 for counting.

ServiceDeskPlusRequestMappingItem.description: A synchronization mapping between a ServiceDeskPlus request and a Flashduty incident.

channel_id.description: Channel ID for the incident.

created_at.description: Mapping record creation time, Unix seconds.

error_message.description: Error message when synchronization failed. Usually absent on successful records.

integration_id.description: ServiceDeskPlus integration ID.

status.description: Synchronization status.

session_id.description: Target session ID, from the list returned by `POST /safari/session/list`.

SessionExportRequest.description: Export the full event transcript of one session as a streaming NDJSON body.

include_subagents.description: When true, each subagent_dispatch line is followed by the child session's full event stream, bracketed by its own session_meta. Defaults to false.

session_id.description: Target session ID, from the list returned by `POST /safari/session/list`.

SessionGetRequest.description: Fetch one session plus a backward-paged window of its most recent events.

limit.description: Page size for events; takes precedence over `num_recent_events`. 0 uses the server default (100).

num_recent_events.description: Legacy page size: number of most-recent events to return. Superseded by `limit` when both are set; 0 uses the server default (100).

search_after_ctx.description: Opaque keyset cursor from a previous response; pass it back to fetch the next older page.

session_id.description: Target session ID, from the list returned by `POST /safari/session/list`.

share_token.description: Share token for accessing a session through its share link. Omit it for normal account-authorized access.

SessionGetResponse.description: A session plus a backward-paged window of its events.

events.description: The newest page of events (older pages via `search_after_ctx`), ascending by (`created_at`, `event_id`). Internal control events are excluded. Always an array.

has_more_older.description: True when older events remain beyond this page.

search_after_ctx.description: Opaque keyset cursor; pass back as search_after_ctx to fetch the next older page. Omitted when has_more_older is false.

pending_messages.description: Human messages queued but not yet picked up by the agent, in execution order. Always an array — empty when nothing is queued.

parent_session_id.description: Parent session id for subagent (child) sessions; empty otherwise.

session_name.description: Session title; may be empty for untitled sessions.

app_name.description: Agent app that owns the session.

entry_kind.description:
Surface that created the session:
- `web`: web console (also returned for subagent child sessions and for sessions that predate this field)
- `im`: IM bot or IM H5 client
- `api`: public API
- `automation`: automation rule (unattended run)

ref.description: Business object the session is about, as a prefixed reference (for example an incident reference). Omitted when the session is not bound to one.

creator_name.description: Display name of the session creator. Returned by `POST /safari/session/list` only; omitted when the name lookup fails.

team_id.description: Owning team id; 0 means no team is bound. Immutable after create.

team_name.description: Resolved team name; empty for unbound rows or deleted teams.

automation.description: Automation rule that produced this session. Returned by `POST /safari/session/get` only, for sessions started by an automation rule.

rule_id.description: ID of the automation rule.

rule_name.description: Rule name; empty when the rule has since been deleted.

trigger_kind.description:
How this run was triggered:
- `schedule`: the rule's schedule fired
- `manual`: run on demand (console or `POST /safari/automation/rule/run`)
- `http_post`: the rule's HTTP trigger URL was called
- `oncall_incident`: an On-call incident event matched the rule
- `war_room_created`: a war room was created
- `""`: the run record no longer exists

can_edit.description: True when the caller may open and manage the rule; false when the rule has been deleted.

is_mine.description: True when the caller created this session.

can_view.description: True when the caller can read this session: always true for the creator, team members, and other members of the same account on a team session; true through a valid share link otherwise.

can_continue.description: True when the caller can add a new turn to this session.

can_manage.description: True when the caller may rename, archive, or delete the session: the creator of a personal session, or the creator or a member of the owning team for a team session. Account owners and admins get no exemption.

can_fork.description: True when the caller can fork this session.

access_source.description:
How the caller obtained access. Omitted when the caller has no access. One of:
| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `owner` | Caller created the session (full access) |
| `team_member` | Caller belongs to the session's team (full access) |
| `manager` | Reserved; not produced by the current version |
| `share_link` | Granted by a valid share link (view and fork only; view only for subagent child sessions) |
| `participant` | Another member of the same account on a team session (view, continue, fork; no manage) |

share_enabled.description: True when the session's share link is active.

share_version.description: Revision of the share link; it increases when sharing is revoked.

shared_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when sharing was last enabled; 0 if never shared.

shared_by.description: Person ID that most recently enabled sharing; 0 if never shared.

status.description: Lifecycle status. Always `enabled` in responses: deleted sessions are never returned.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the session was created.

updated_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds of the last session update.

template_staging_round_id.description: Current save→validate round id (template-assistant only); empty otherwise.

state.description: Raw session-state key/value map. Returned by `POST /safari/session/get` only; omitted when empty.

current_context_tokens.description: Size in tokens of the LLM context window as of the most recent turn. 0 means no turn has completed.

context_window.description: Maximum context size of the session's model, in tokens. Computed by `POST /safari/session/get` only; always 0 in list responses and when the lookup fails.

archived_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when archived; 0 means not archived.

pinned_at.description: When the caller pinned this session, as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds; 0 when not pinned. Pins are per user. Filled by `POST /safari/session/list` only; always 0 in `POST /safari/session/get`.

last_event_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds of the latest assistant-side event; user messages alone do not advance it. Omitted when 0.

is_running.description: True when an agent turn is currently in flight for this session.

standing_tasks.description: Number of the session's process-type tasks (background shell commands or monitors) still alive when the response was built; 0 when none or when the count cannot be read.

has_unread.description: True when assistant output exists that the caller has not viewed yet; always false while `is_running` is true. Computed by `POST /safari/session/list` only; always false in `POST /safari/session/get`.

has_open_tasks.description: True when the session still has open tasks (for example running subagents or background processes), which tells a handed-off turn apart from a settled session. Returned by `POST /safari/session/get` only; omitted when false or when the lookup fails, so treat absence as unknown rather than idle.

current_turn_started_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the current or most recent round started; 0 if no round has started yet.

current_turn_active_ms.description: Active working duration in milliseconds for the current or most recent round, excluding time spent waiting on ask_user; resets to 0 at the start of each new round.

current_turn_wait_ms.description: Accumulated ask_user human-wait duration in milliseconds for the current round; resets to 0 at the start of each new round.

current_turn_tokens.description: Total tokens (input+output+reasoning) for the in-flight round across the parent and its subagents; only computed by session/get while the session is running, always 0 in session/list responses and when idle.

SessionListRequest.description: Filters for listing agent sessions. `all` visibility means the caller's own personal sessions plus accessible team sessions; account admins do not see other users' personal sessions.

app_name.description:
Agent app whose sessions to list. One of:
| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `ask-ai` | Ask AI assistant |
| `support` | Customer-support agent |
| `support-website` | Website support agent (exposed over A2A, not built into the console) |
| `support-flashcat` | Flashcat-site support agent (exposed over A2A) |
| `ai-sre` | The AI SRE main app |
| `template-assistant` | Notification-template assistant (template editing/validation) |
| `query-assistant` | Monitors query-writing assistant |
| `swe` | Software-engineering agent app (not offered in the console) |

limit.description: Page size, 1–100.

orderby.description: Sort field: `created_at` by creation time, `updated_at` by last update; defaults to `updated_at` when omitted.

asc.description: Ascending order when true, descending when false. Only honored together with `orderby`; when `orderby` is omitted the sort is always `updated_at` descending.

include_subagent_sessions.description: When true, also list child sessions spawned by subagent dispatch. Defaults to false (top-level sessions only).

keyword.description: Return only sessions whose `session_name` contains this text; leading and trailing spaces are ignored.

scope.description:
Visibility scope:
- `all` (default): sessions the caller created plus sessions bound to teams the caller belongs to
- `personal`: the caller's own sessions with no team (`team_id` = 0)
- `team`: sessions bound to teams the caller belongs to; empty when the caller is in no team

team_ids.description: Optional explicit team filter; intersects with `scope` and never expands access.

person_ids.description: Filter by who started the session: returns only sessions started by these members (a session is kept when `person_id` matches any of them). Intersects with `scope` and `team_ids`, so it never widens what the caller is allowed to see.

entry_kinds.description: Restrict to sessions created from these surfaces: `web` (console), `im` (IM bot or IM H5), `api` (public API), `automation` (automation rule). Empty returns every kind.

status.description:
Archive filter:
- `active` (default): sessions that are not archived
- `archived`: archived sessions only
- `all`: both

total.description: Number of matching sessions, ignoring pagination. Pinned sessions prepended on page 1 are not counted.

sessions.description: The page of sessions: on page 1, the caller's matching pinned sessions (newest pin first) followed by up to `limit` other sessions in the requested order.

SessionTokenUsage.description: Cumulative session-level token rollup across all turns. The account-billing source of truth.

cached_tokens.description: Portion of input_tokens served from the prompt cache.

input_tokens.description: Total prompt (input) tokens, including the cached portion.

SignedURLs.description: Short-lived signed URLs for downloading or previewing a file.

download_url.description: Relative URL (`/safari/artifact/stream?...`) that serves the file as an attachment. Prepend the API base `https://api.flashcat.cloud` before use; expires with `expires_in`.

preview_url.description: Same as `download_url` but served inline for browser preview.

expires_in.description: Validity of both URLs in seconds. Always `300`.

frame_url.description: Sandboxed iframe URL (`/safari/artifact/f/<token>/<file name>`) that serves this file for an embedded preview. The token in the path is its only credential; it expires with `frame_expires_in`.

frame_base.description: Frame URL directory of this artifact version, ending with `/`; append a file's relative path to load any file of a multi-file version. Empty, and therefore omitted, for single-object rows, whose frame route resolves only the file's own name.

frame_expires_in.description: Validity of `frame_url` and `frame_base` in seconds. Always `43200` (12 hours).

name.description: File name including extension.

content_type.description: MIME type, derived from the file-name extension when the file was produced: `text/html` (.html/.htm), `text/markdown` (.md), `text/plain` (.txt/.log), `text/csv`, `text/yaml` (.yaml/.yml), `text/x-python`, `text/x-go`, `text/x-sh`, `application/json`, `application/xml`, `application/pdf`, `image/png`, `image/jpeg`, `image/gif`, `image/svg+xml`, `image/webp`, `application/zip`, `application/gzip` (.tar/.gz/.tgz); any other extension is `application/octet-stream`.

account_id.description: ID of the account the rule belongs to.

channel_id.description: ID of the channel the rule belongs to.

from_incident_id.description: Incident the rule is attached to. Always present; the zero ObjectID `000000000000000000000000` means the rule was not created from an incident.

time_filters.description: Recurring silence windows. Empty when the rule uses a one-off `time_filter`.

time_filter.description: One-off silence window. Present with zero values when the rule uses recurring `time_filters` instead.

filters.description: Alert event conditions (OR of AND groups); matching events are silenced while the time window is active.

is_directly_discard.description: When true, matching alert events are discarded entirely; when false, alerts are still recorded but marked as silenced by this rule.

status.description: Rule status: `enabled` or `disabled`; deleted rules never appear in the list.

rule_id.description: Rule ID (MongoDB ObjectID).

updated_by.description: ID of the user who last updated the rule.

created_at.description: Creation time, Unix timestamp in seconds.

updated_at.description: Last update time, Unix timestamp in seconds.

is_effective.description: Whether the rule's time window covers the current moment, evaluated at response time.

is_auto_delete.description: When true, the rule is permanently removed about 24 hours after its one-off window ends; rules with recurring windows are never removed. Returned only when `true`.

deleted_at.description: Deletion time, Unix timestamp in seconds. Omitted unless the rule is soft-deleted; deleted rules are excluded from list responses.

skill_id.description: Target skill ID, from the list returned by `POST /safari/skill/list`.
Target skill ID, from the list returned by `POST /safari/skill/list`.

SkillItem.description: An AI SRE skill — a packaged SKILL.md bundle the agent can load.

account_id.description: Owning account ID.

team_id.description: Team scope: 0 = account-wide; >0 = the owning team.

skill_name.description: Skill name, unique within its scope (account-wide or within one team).

description.description: Human-readable description from the SKILL.md frontmatter.

description_en.description: Optional English description. English-locale UI responses prefer this over `description`; the skill catalog also uses it as a stable selection signal when `description` is localized for display.

content.description: Full SKILL.md content. Omitted in list responses.

version.description: Skill version from the frontmatter.

tags.description: Tags parsed from the frontmatter.

venues.description: Execution environments the skill is restricted to: `cloud` (managed sandbox) and/or `byoc` (self-hosted runner). Omitted when empty, which means every environment.

s3_key.description: Object-storage key of the skill zip.

checksum.description: SHA-256 checksum of the skill zip.

status.description: Skill status: `enabled` (agents load it) or `disabled` (kept but not loaded). Deleted skills never appear in responses.

created_by.description: Member ID that created the skill.

created_at.description: Creation time. Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

updated_at.description: Last update time. Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

can_edit.description: True when the caller may change this skill: account owners and admins for account-scope skills, team members for team skills.

source_template_name.description: Marketplace template this skill was installed from; empty for user-authored.

update_available.description: True when the marketplace template this skill was installed from has a newer version. Computed by `POST /safari/skill/list` only; always false in other responses.

is_modified.description: True when a marketplace-installed skill was changed locally (for example by uploading a new archive); automatic marketplace updates skip it.

created.description: Not returned by these endpoints; it is set only by the install-from-session flow.

examples.description: Example prompts declared in the SKILL.md frontmatter (up to 10), shown as suggested questions. Omitted when none.

SkillListRequest.description: Pagination, search, and team filter for listing skills.

p.description: Page number, 1-based; values below 1 fall back to 1.

limit.description: Page size; values below 1 fall back to 20.

scope.description:
Which skills to return; overrides `include_account` when set:
- `all` (default): account-scope skills (unless `include_account` is false) plus the caller's team skills
- `account`: account-scope skills only (`team_id` = 0)
- `team`: the caller's team skills only

query.description: Free-text search across skill name, description, English description, skill ID, marketplace source template name, and author.

team_ids.description: Limit team-scope results to these team IDs; IDs of teams the caller does not belong to are dropped. Empty = all of the caller's teams.

include_account.description: Include account-scoped (team_id=0) rows. Defaults to true. Ignored when `scope` is `account` or `team`.

total.description: Total number of matching skills.

skill_id.description: Target skill ID, from the list returned by `POST /safari/skill/list`.

description.description: New description. Cannot contain `<` or `>`. Sending an empty string leaves the current value unchanged — there is no way to clear it via this field.

description_en.description: New English description. Cannot contain `<` or `>`. Omit to leave unchanged; send an empty string to explicitly clear it.

skill_id.description: Target skill ID, from the list returned by `POST /safari/skill/list`.

team_id.description: Reassign team scope: 0 = account-wide; >0 = team. Omit to leave unchanged.

SkillUploadRequest.description: Multipart form for uploading a skill archive.

file.description: Skill archive (`.skill`, `.zip`, `.tar.gz`, or `.tgz`), up to 100 MB, containing `SKILL.md` at its root or inside a single top-level folder.

team_id.description: Scope for the created or overwritten-by-name skill: 0 = account scope (default), >0 = that team. Ignored when `replace=true` and `skill_id` are both set.

replace.description: When true, overwrite an existing skill instead of failing on a name clash: the skill given by `skill_id`, or else the same-named skill in `team_id`. Accepts `true`, `1`, `yes`, `on` (case-insensitive); anything else is false.

skill_id.description: ID of the skill to overwrite, from `POST /safari/skill/list`. Used only together with `replace=true`; ignored otherwise.

SnoozeIncidentRequest.description: Parameters for snoozing notifications on one or more incidents.

incident_ids.description: Incident IDs to snooze. At most 100 per call.

minutes.description: Duration in minutes. Must be greater than 0 and at most 43,200 (30 days).

SourcemapBinaryImage.description: Loaded binary image from a crash report.

arch.description: CPU architecture for this binary image.

is_system.description: Whether this binary belongs to the operating system.

load_address.description: Runtime address. Accepts a hex string such as `0x100000000` or a decimal integer.

max_address.description: Runtime address. Accepts a hex string such as `0x100000000` or a decimal integer.

name.description: Binary image name.

uuid.description: Build UUID identifying the binary or dSYM.

SourcemapCodeSnippet.description: One source-code line returned around an enriched frame.

code_snippets.description: Source-code snippets around this frame. Omitted when no snippet was extracted (for example the source content was unavailable or `near` was not requested).

converted.description: Whether the frame was successfully symbolicated or deobfuscated.

original_frame.description: The original minified/obfuscated frame before enrichment. Omitted when the processor did not retain one.

third_party.description: Whether the frame is from third-party or system libraries (Android and native symbolication only). Omitted when `false`.

created_at.description: Upload timestamp, Unix epoch seconds.

git_commit_sha.description: Git commit SHA for this build.

git_repository_url.description: Git repository URL associated with this build.

key.description: Record identifier: a 32-character MD5 hex digest derived from the uploaded file's identity (storage path, or service/version/build identifiers for native symbols).

metadata.description: Platform-specific metadata: `minified_url` (browser/react-native/harmony/miniprogram); `build_id`, `variant`, `version_code` (android mappings), plus `arch`, `lib_name`, `code_id` (android/harmony/electron native symbols); `uuid` (ios); `build_id`, `platform`, `arch`, `flavor`, `code_id`, `debug_id` (flutter); `subpackage`, `minified_url` (miniprogram). Omitted when empty.

minified_path.description: Deprecated. Storage path of the minified file; present only on JavaScript records.

minified_url.description: Deprecated. URL of the minified file; present only on JavaScript and miniprogram records. New integrations should read `metadata.minified_url`.

sourcemap_path.description: Deprecated. Storage path of the sourcemap file; present only on JavaScript and miniprogram records.

type.description:
Platform store this record belongs to. JavaScript rows always report `browser` (including HarmonyOS ArkTS and React Native uploads); native-symbol rows always report `android` (including HarmonyOS native and Electron uploads).

| Value | Store |
|---|---|
| `browser` | JavaScript sourcemap store |
| `android` | Android mapping store, or the shared native symbol store |
| `ios` | iOS dSYM store |
| `miniprogram` | WeChat mini program sourcemap store |
| `flutter` | Flutter Dart AOT symbol store |

updated_at.description: Last update timestamp, Unix epoch seconds.

version.description: Application version string.

asc.description: Sort ascending. Default false (descending).

build_id.description: Substring filter on the build ID (Android Gradle plugin build identifier, or the build ID of native symbols). Max 200 characters.

end_time.description: End of upload time range, Unix epoch milliseconds. Maximum window: 365 days.

kind.description: Symbol type filter, Android and HarmonyOS only (ignored for other platforms): `mapping` (default) lists ProGuard/R8 mappings or ArkTS sourcemaps, `native` lists native .so symbols.

limit.description: Page size. Maximum 100. Default 20.

orderby.description: Sort field; defaults to `created_at` descending when omitted.

query.description: Free-text substring match. Matches `minified_url` for the JS stores (browser/react-native/harmony/miniprogram), `build_id` for android/flutter/electron and harmony with `kind=native`, or `uuid` for ios (case-insensitive, hyphens ignored).

services.description: Filter by service names. Up to 100 values.

start_time.description: Start of upload time range, Unix epoch milliseconds. Must be > 0 and before `end_time`.

type.description:
Platform whose symbol store to list. Defaults to `browser` when omitted; any other value returns an empty list.

| Value | Store listed |
|---|---|
| `browser` | JavaScript sourcemaps (shared store; excludes HarmonyOS ArkTS and React Native rows) |
| `android` | ProGuard/R8 mapping files; with `kind=native`, Android NDK .so symbols |
| `ios` | iOS dSYM symbol files |
| `miniprogram` | WeChat mini program sourcemaps |
| `react-native` | React Native JS sourcemaps |
| `harmony` | HarmonyOS ArkTS sourcemaps; with `kind=native`, HarmonyOS .so symbols |
| `flutter` | Flutter Dart AOT symbols |
| `electron` | Electron Breakpad symbols |

uuid.description: iOS only. Substring filter on the dSYM UUID; upper-cased and stripped of hyphens before matching. Max 200 characters.

versions.description: Filter by version strings. Up to 100 values.

items.description: Sourcemap records of the current page. Omitted when empty.

total.description: Total number of matching records. Omitted when 0.

arch.description: Native CPU architecture, such as `arm`, `arm64`, `x86` or `x64`. With `type: android` and an empty `source_type`, sending `arch` selects NDK native symbolication.

binary_images.description: Loaded binary images from an iOS crash report.

build_id.description: Android build ID for Gradle plugin 1.13.0 and later.

near.description: Number of nearby meaningful source lines to return around converted frames.

no_cache.description: Skip cached enrich results. Intended for debugging.

platform.description: Narrows a `react-native` enrich to the app's native platform: `ios` for the iOS native layer, `android` for the Android native layer (the console derives it from the event's OS). Ignored for other `type` values.

service.description: Application or service name used when the sourcemap was uploaded.

source_type.description: The error's `error.source_type` as reported by the SDK. It reroutes symbolication: for `android`, a value containing `ndk` selects NDK native symbols; for `flutter` and `react-native`, `ios` selects dSYM and `android`/`ndk` selects Android symbols; for `electron`, `macos`, `windows` or `linux` selects Breakpad symbols. Ignored for other types.

stack.description: Raw stack trace to parse and enrich.

type.description:
Source platform whose symbol store is used. Defaults to `browser` when omitted.

| Value | Symbolication |
|---|---|
| `browser` | JavaScript stacks via sourcemaps |
| `android` | Java/Kotlin stacks via ProGuard/R8 mappings; native stacks via NDK symbols (send `source_type=ndk` with `arch`) |
| `ios` | iOS crash stacks via dSYM (send `binary_images`) |
| `miniprogram` | WeChat mini program stacks via sourcemaps |
| `harmony` | HarmonyOS stacks via ArkTS sourcemaps or native symbols |
| `flutter` | Flutter/Dart stacks via Dart AOT symbols |
| `electron` | Electron JavaScript stacks via sourcemaps; minidump native frames via Breakpad symbols (derived from `source_type`) |
| `react-native` | React Native JS stacks via sourcemaps; narrow the lookup with `platform` |

variant.description: Android build variant used by older Gradle plugin versions.

version.description: Application version used when the sourcemap was uploaded.

frames.description: Error stack frames after symbolication (via sourcemap, dSYM, NDK symbol tables, etc.).

SourcemapStackFrame.description: Parsed stack frame fields shared across platforms.

column.description: Column number for JavaScript or Flutter frames.

file.description: Source file, URL, or module path.

method_name.description: Android Java/Kotlin method name without class prefix.

StatusPageChangeCreateResponse.description: Result of creating a status page event.

StatusPageChangeItem.description: A status page event (incident or maintenance).

change_id.description: Event ID, returned by `POST /status-page/change/create`; pass it as `change_id` to the other event endpoints.

page_id.description: Parent status page ID. Omitted when 0 (never for stored events).

type.description: Change type. `incident` is an unplanned outage; `maintenance` is a planned maintenance. The type determines which status values are valid.

status.description: Current event status. Incident statuses: `investigating`/`identified`/`monitoring`/`resolved`. Maintenance statuses: `scheduled`/`ongoing`/`completed`. Omitted when empty (never for stored events).

affected_components.description: Components currently affected by this event, with their resulting status. Omitted when no components are affected.

responder_ids.description: Member IDs responsible for this event. Omitted when no responders are assigned.

linked_change_ids.description: Linked event IDs (related incidents, deployments, etc.). Omitted when empty.

start_at_seconds.description: Event start time in Unix seconds. For incidents it is the time of the first timeline entry; for maintenances it is the scheduled start given at creation, or the first entry's time when none was given. Omitted when 0.

close_at_seconds.description: Event close time in Unix seconds. For maintenances this is the scheduled end time; for closed events, the time the event reached its terminal status (`resolved`/`completed`). Omitted when not set.

is_retrospective.description: Whether this event is a retrospective (historical) one. Omitted when false.

updates.description: Timeline updates attached to this event, ordered by time. Omitted when the event has no timeline updates.

notify_subscribers.description: Whether subscribers were notified about this event. Omitted when false.

auto_update_by_schedule.description: Maintenance only: whether the status advances automatically based on the scheduled window. Omitted when false.

items.description: Status page changes (incidents/maintenances) matching the filters.

StatusPageChangeTimelineCreateResponse.description: Result of appending a timeline update to a status page event.

StatusPageChangeUpdateItem.description: A single timeline update on a status page event.

update_id.description: Timeline entry ID (a ULID string), assigned by the server; pass it as `update_id` to edit or delete the entry.

status.description:
Change status after this update. Omitted when the update does not change the overall status. The first four values apply to incident-type changes, the last three to maintenance-type changes.
| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `investigating` | Investigating (incident). |
| `identified` | Root cause identified (incident). |
| `monitoring` | Fix deployed, monitoring (incident). |
| `resolved` | Resolved (incident). |
| `scheduled` | Scheduled (maintenance). |
| `ongoing` | In progress (maintenance). |
| `completed` | Completed (maintenance). |

component_changes.description: Component status transitions applied by this update. Omitted when the update changes no component statuses.

StatusPageComponentChangeItem.description: Component status transition applied in a timeline update.

component_id.description: ID of the component whose status changes; matches `component_id` in `GET /status-page/info`.

component_name.description: Component display name. Populated by the backend on read; ignored on write. Omitted when empty.

status.description: New component status. Incidents support `operational`/`degraded`/`partial_outage`/`full_outage`; maintenances support `operational`/`under_maintenance`.

available_since_seconds.description: Time the component became available, as a Unix timestamp in seconds. Omitted when 0.

hide_all.description: When true, the component is hidden entirely from summary endpoints. Omitted when false.

hide_uptime.description: When true, uptime data is hidden from summary responses. Omitted when false.

name.description: Component display name.

order_id.description: Display order within its section. Omitted when 0.

section_id.description: Parent section ID. Omitted when the component sits at the top level.

StatusPageDraftCreateResponse.description: Result of storing a status page draft.

draft_id.description: Draft ID matching `draft_[A-Za-z0-9]{22}`; pass it as `draft_id` to `POST /status-page/change/create` or `POST /status-page/change/timeline/create` to publish.

created_at.description: Creation time in Unix epoch seconds.

managed_domain_feature_enabled.description: Whether the managed custom-domain feature is enabled for this page. `true` for public pages, always `false` for internal pages.

StatusPageInfoResponse.description: Status page detail returned by `GET /status-page/info`: the full page configuration plus feature flags.

page_id.description: Status page ID.

name.description: Display name of the status page.

url_name.description: URL-safe slug of the page, unique among the account's pages of the same type.

type.description: Page visibility type. `public` pages are accessible to anyone and use email subscriptions; `internal` pages are restricted to account members and use IM subscriptions.

custom_domain.description: Custom domain pointing to the status page. Omitted when not set.

logo.description: Logo image of the status page. Omitted when not set.

dark_logo.description: Dark-mode logo image of the status page. Omitted when not set.

logo_url.description: URL opened when the logo is clicked. Omitted when not set.

favicon.description: Favicon of the status page. Omitted when not set.

page_header.description: Header content of the status page. Omitted when not set.

page_footer.description: Footer content of the status page. Omitted when not set.

date_view.description: How the timeline displays change dates. `calendar` uses a calendar view; `list` uses a list view. Omitted when not set.

display_uptime_mode.description: How uptime is displayed. `chart_and_percentage` shows both the uptime chart and the percentage figure; `chart` shows only the chart; `none` hides uptime entirely. Omitted when not set.

key.description: Link text shown on the page.

value.description: URL the link text points to, such as `https://www.example.com`.

custom_links.description: Custom navigation links shown on the status page. Omitted when not set.

contact_info.description: Get-in-touch contact, a mailto or website URL. Omitted when not set.

components.description: Components tracked on the status page.

template_preference.description: Event template mode used when publishing events in the console: `message` (status descriptions: per-status texts) or `pre_defined` (full status updates: complete examples with title, status, and description). Omitted when never set; the console then uses `message`.

StatusPageMessageTemplate.description: A message template: per-status notification texts for one change type. In `POST /status-page/template/upsert`, omit `template_id` to create and supply it to update; on update only non-empty fields are applied.

messages.description: Notification text (Markdown) per event status. Keys are change statuses valid for the template's `type` (for example `investigating` or `resolved` for incidents); the value is the text used when the event reaches that status.

template_id.description: Template ID. Omit to create a new template; supply to update an existing one.

type.description: Change type the template applies to: `incident` unplanned incident, `maintenance` planned maintenance.

StatusPageMigrationJob.description: A migration job's current state and progress.

account_id.description: Owner account ID.

target_page_id.description: Flashduty target status page ID. For a structure migration it is 0 until the page is created or reused; for a subscriber migration it is the `target_page_id` from the request.

phase.description: Current migration phase. `structure` imports the page structure (sections and components); `history` imports historical incidents, maintenances, and incident templates; `subscribers` imports email subscribers.

status.description:
Current job status.
| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `running` | In progress. |
| `completed` | Finished successfully. |
| `failed` | Failed; the `error` field holds the reason. |
| `cancelled` | Canceled by request. |

error.description: Terminal error message when `status` is `failed`. Omitted when the job has not failed.

created_at.description: Job creation time as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

updated_at.description: Last status update time as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

StatusPageMigrationProgress.description: Progress counters for a migration job.

total_steps.description: Total steps of the job: 5 for a structure migration (page, sections, components, incidents and maintenances, templates) and 1 for a subscriber migration.

components_imported.description: Number of components imported from the source status page.

sections_imported.description: Number of sections (Atlassian component groups) imported from the source status page.

subscribers_imported.description: Number of email subscribers successfully imported.

templates_imported.description: Number of incident templates successfully imported; templates that fail are skipped and recorded in `warnings`.

subscribers_skipped.description: Number of source subscribers skipped because they are not email subscribers, have no email address, or are quarantined. Recipients already subscribed on the target page are not counted here.

warnings.description: Non-fatal warnings recorded during the job. Omitted when empty.

StatusPageMigrationStartResponse.description: Result of starting a migration job.

job_id.description: Migration job ID. Use this to poll status or request cancellation.

StatusPagePreDefinedTemplate.description: A predefined event template: a reusable draft of an event's title, type, status, and description. In `POST /status-page/template/upsert`, omit `template_id` to create and supply it to update; on update only non-empty fields are applied.

template_id.description: Template ID. Omit to create a new template; supply to update an existing one.

type.description: Change type the template applies to: `incident` unplanned incident, `maintenance` planned maintenance. Set on create; ignored on update.

status.description: Change status the template maps to. Incidents use `investigating`/`identified`/`monitoring`/`resolved`; maintenances use `scheduled`/`ongoing`/`completed`.

hide_all.description: Whether the section and its components are hidden from summary endpoints.

hide_uptime.description: Whether uptime data is hidden from summary responses.

name.description: Section name.

order_id.description: Display order of the section. Omitted when 0.

StatusPageSubscriberExportResponse.description: A CSV file (Content-Type: text/csv; charset=utf-8) containing columns: Method, Recipient, Components, Subscribe All, Locale.

StatusPageSubscriberListResponse.description: Paginated list of status page subscribers.

has_next_page.description: Whether there is at least one more page after the current one.

items.description: Subscribers on the current page.

total.description: Total matching subscribers.

StringMapPatch.description: Partial update for a map field: keys in `set` are inserted or replaced, keys in `delete` are removed, all other keys are preserved. At least one of `set` / `delete` must be non-empty, keys must not be blank, and a key may not appear in both or twice in `delete`.

SuccessEnvelope.description: Success response envelope. On every 2xx response, `request_id` identifies the call (also mirrored in the `Flashcat-Request-Id` header) and `data` holds the endpoint-specific payload. Failure responses use a different shape — see `ErrorResponse`.

request_id.description: Unique ID for this request. Mirrored in the Flashcat-Request-Id response header. Include it when reporting issues.

data.description: Operation-specific payload, documented in each operation's 200 response. Operations without a payload return `{}` or omit `data` entirely.

TeamBriefItem.description: Brief team info for batch responses.

team_id.description: Team ID, one of the requested `team_ids`.

team_name.description: Team name. Deleted teams are included, so this can be the name of a team that no longer appears in `POST /team/list`.

person_ids.description: Array of person IDs belonging to the team; empty array (never null) when the team has no members.

TeamDeleteRequest.description: Request identifying a team to delete.

ref_id.description: External reference ID. Only used when neither `team_id` nor `team_name` is provided.

team_id.description: Team ID. At least one of the three lookup fields is required; when several are provided, `team_id` wins.

team_name.description: Team name. Only used when `team_id` is not provided.

TeamInfoRequest.description: Request identifying a team by one of ID, name, or external ref.

ref_id.description: External reference ID. When provided, takes precedence over `team_name` and `team_id`.

team_id.description: Team ID. At least one of the three lookup fields is required; lowest priority — only used when neither `ref_id` nor `team_name` is provided.

team_name.description: Team name. Only used when `ref_id` is not provided; takes precedence over `team_id`.

TeamInfosRequest.description: Request for batch team lookup by IDs.

team_ids.description: List of team IDs to look up.

items.description: Brief info for the matched teams, including deleted ones; `null` when no ID matches.

account_id.description: Owning account ID.

team_id.description: Unique team ID.

team_name.description: Team display name. 1–39 characters, unique per account.

status.description: Team status. `enabled` — active; `deleted` — soft-deleted (only possible when fetching a deleted team by `team_id`; list and name/ref_id lookups exclude deleted teams).

updated_by_name.description: Name of the last editor: the member's name, or the account name when the account owner made the change; empty string when unknown.

updated_by.description: Member ID of the last editor.

creator_id.description: Member ID of the creator.

creator_name.description: Display name of the creator. Not populated by current endpoints — always an empty string; resolve `creator_id` via `POST /person/infos`.

created_at.description: Unix epoch seconds the team was created.

updated_at.description: Unix epoch seconds the team was last updated.

person_ids.description: Person IDs of the team's members (member IDs; the account owner's ID when the owner is in the team). Empty array when the team has no members.

ref_id.description: External reference ID for third-party HR system integration.

asc.description: Ascending sort order. Default: false (descending).

limit.description: Page size. Max: 100. Default: 20.

orderby.description: Sort field. Default: `updated_at`.

person_id.description: Filter by member ID — return only teams this person belongs to.

query.description: Substring match on team name or description.

p.description: Page number from the request; `0` when `p` was omitted (the first page is returned).

limit.description: Page size applied; 20 when `limit` was omitted.

total.description: Number of non-deleted teams matching the filters, across all pages.

items.description: Array of teams for the current page, used with `p`, `limit` and `total` for pagination; empty array on an empty page.

TeamUpsertRequest.description: Parameters for creating or updating a team.

team_id.description: ID of the team to update. Omit or set to 0 to create a new team; a non-zero ID must belong to an existing team of the account.

description.description: Free-form description, up to 500 characters. On update, omitting it clears the stored description.

person_ids.description: Person IDs to place in the team (member IDs, or the account ID for the account owner). Together with `emails` and `phones` they replace the entire member list; IDs that are not members of the account are ignored.

emails.description: Emails of existing members to place in the team; merged with `person_ids` and `phones`. Addresses that match no member are ignored and no invitation is sent.

phones.description: Phone numbers of existing members to place in the team; merged with `person_ids` and `emails`. Numbers without a `+` prefix are parsed with `countryCode`; an unparseable number fails the whole request with `400`, and numbers that match no member are ignored.

countryCode.description: Region hint for `phones` entries without a `+` prefix: an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code such as `CN` (the default when omitted) or a digit calling code such as `86`.

ref_id.description: External reference ID (for example a department ID in an HR system), usable as a lookup key in `POST /team/info` and `POST /team/delete`. On update, omitting it clears the stored value.

reset_if_name_exist.description: When true and `team_id` is 0, an existing team with the same `team_name` is updated in place instead of returning a name-conflict error.

team_id.description: Created or updated team ID.

team_name.description: Team name echoed from the request.

team_id.description: Owning team ID from `POST /team/list`; `0` (default) means account-wide. A non-zero ID must be an existing team.

template_name.description: Template name, 1–39 characters, unique among the account's non-deleted templates and different from the built-in preset template's name in every supported language.

wecom_markdown_v2_enabled.description: Send WeCom robot notifications as `markdown_v2` messages instead of plain markdown. While enabled, the rendered `wecom` content must be at most 4,096 bytes.

feishu_app_card_v2_table_enabled.description: Render Markdown tables in the `feishu_app` content as native Feishu card tables.

feishu_app_card_v2_preserve_blank_lines.description: Keep blank lines in the body of Feishu app card v2 messages.

feishu_app_war_room_enabled.description: Show the Create War Room button on Feishu app cards.

dingtalk_app_war_room_enabled.description: Show the Create War Room button on DingTalk app cards.

slack_app_war_room_enabled.description: Show the Create War Room button on Slack app cards.

teams_app.description: Microsoft Teams app message template source.

incident_card_closed_action_apps.description: IM apps whose closed-incident cards keep the custom action buttons. Supported values: `feishu_app`, `dingtalk_app`, `wecom_app`, `slack_app`, `teams_app`. An empty list hides the buttons on every app.

incident_card_hidden_fields.description: Incident card fields to hide per IM app type.

template_id.description: Newly created template ID.

template_name.description: Template name echoed from the request.

TemplateIDRequest.description: Request body carrying a template ID.

template_id.description: Target template ID. Pass `6321aad26c12104586a88916` to address the built-in preset.

TemplateItem.description: A notification template. Each channel field holds the template source string for that delivery channel; an empty string means 'no custom template for that channel'.

account_id.description: ID of the owning account.

team_id.description: ID of the team this template is scoped to, or 0 for account-wide.

template_id.description: Template ID (24-character hex). The built-in preset template always has the ID `6321aad26c12104586a88916`.

template_name.description: Unique template name within the account.

description.description: Free-form description (up to 500 characters); empty string when none was given.

wecom_markdown_v2_enabled.description: Whether WeCom robot notifications use the `markdown_v2` message format.

feishu_app_card_v2_table_enabled.description: Whether Markdown tables in the `feishu_app` content are rendered as native Feishu card tables.

feishu_app_card_v2_preserve_blank_lines.description: Whether Feishu app card v2 messages keep blank lines in the body.

dingtalk_app_war_room_enabled.description: Whether DingTalk app cards show the Create War Room button. Hidden for closed incidents and when the incident has no responders.

slack_app_war_room_enabled.description: Whether Slack app cards show the Create War Room button. Hidden for closed incidents and when the incident has no responders.

teams_app.description: Microsoft Teams app message template source.

incident_card_closed_action_apps.description: IM apps whose cards for closed incidents keep the custom action buttons (open incidents always show them). Values: `feishu_app`, `dingtalk_app`, `wecom_app`, `slack_app`, `teams_app`. Empty or `null` hides the buttons on closed-incident cards in every app.

incident_card_hidden_fields.description: Incident card fields hidden per IM app type; an empty object when none are configured.

status.description:
Template status.
- `enabled`: usable by escalation rules.
- `disabled`: not used for new notifications; cannot be set through this API.
- `deleted`: soft-deleted by `/template/delete`; excluded from `/template/list` but still returned by `/template/info`.

updated_by.description: Member ID of the last editor.

deleted_at.description: Unix epoch seconds the template was soft-deleted. Absent (omitempty) when the template is live.

created_at.description: Unix epoch seconds the template was created.

updated_at.description: Unix epoch seconds the template was last updated.

TemplateListRequest.description: Paginated list filters. Defaults: p=1, limit=20. Max limit=100.

limit.description: Page size. Capped at 100.

orderby.description: Sort field: `created_at` (default, creation time) or `updated_at` (last update time).

asc.description: Sort ascending when `true`; defaults to newest first.

is_my_team.description: When `true`, only templates of teams the caller belongs to are returned. If `team_ids` is also sent, only teams in both lists are kept. When they share no team, or the caller belongs to no team, the result is empty.

team_ids.description: Return only templates of these team IDs (from `POST /team/list`); `0` selects account-wide templates. Empty or omitted applies no team filter. See `is_my_team` for how the two combine.

creator_id.description: Filter by creator member ID; obtain member IDs from `POST /member/list`.

query.description: Case-insensitive regular expression matched against `template_name`; an invalid expression is matched as literal text.

has_next_page.description: True if another page exists after the returned one.

items.description: Notification templates on the current page; the first item of the first page is always the built-in preset template.

total.description: Total number of templates matching the filter, across all pages (including the built-in preset template).

template_id.description: Target template ID; obtain it from `POST /template/list`.

team_id.description: Team scope. 0 for account-wide. Omit to keep the template's current team.

template_name.description: Template name, 1–39 characters. Required and written on every call; must not be used by another template.

description.description: Free-form description. Up to 500 characters. Omit to keep the current content; send an empty string to clear it.

email.description: Email body template source (Go `html/template` syntax). Omit to keep the current content; send an empty string to clear it.

sms.description: SMS template source (Go `text/template` syntax). Omit to keep the current content; send an empty string to clear it.

voice.description: Voice call script template source. Omit to keep the current content; send an empty string to clear it.

dingtalk.description: DingTalk robot message template source. Omit to keep the current content; send an empty string to clear it.

wecom.description: WeCom robot message template source. Omit to keep the current content; send an empty string to clear it.

wecom_markdown_v2_enabled.description: Send WeCom robot notifications as `markdown_v2` messages instead of plain markdown. While enabled, the rendered `wecom` content must be at most 4,096 bytes. Omit to keep the current setting.

feishu.description: Feishu robot message template source. Omit to keep the current content; send an empty string to clear it.

feishu_app.description: Feishu app message template source. Omit to keep the current content; send an empty string to clear it.

feishu_app_card_v2_table_enabled.description: Render Markdown tables in the `feishu_app` content as native Feishu card tables. Omit to keep the current setting.

feishu_app_card_v2_preserve_blank_lines.description: When set, keep or drop blank lines in the body of Feishu app card v2 messages. Omit to keep the existing setting.

feishu_app_war_room_enabled.description: When set, show or hide the Create War Room button on Feishu app cards. Omit to keep the existing setting.

dingtalk_app_war_room_enabled.description: When set, show or hide the Create War Room button on DingTalk app cards. Omit to keep the existing setting.

slack_app_war_room_enabled.description: When set, show or hide the Create War Room button on Slack app cards. Omit to keep the existing setting.

dingtalk_app.description: DingTalk app message template source. Omit to keep the current content; send an empty string to clear it.

wecom_app.description: WeCom app message template source. Omit to keep the current content; send an empty string to clear it.

slack_app.description: Slack app message template source. Omit to keep the current content; send an empty string to clear it.

teams_app.description: Microsoft Teams app message template source. Omit to keep the current content; send an empty string to clear it.

telegram.description: Telegram bot message template source. Omit to keep the current content; send an empty string to clear it.

slack.description: Slack robot message template source. Omit to keep the current content; send an empty string to clear it.

zoom.description: Zoom bot message template source. Omit to keep the current content; send an empty string to clear it.

incident_card_closed_action_apps.description: Replaces the retained-app list when sent. Supported values: `feishu_app`, `dingtalk_app`, `wecom_app`, `slack_app`, `teams_app`. Omit the field to leave it unchanged.

incident_card_hidden_fields.description: Incident card fields to hide per IM app type. When sent, replaces the stored value as a whole; omit to keep.

TimeFilter.description: Recurring time window. `start` and `end` are `HH:MM` in 24-hour format with `start` not later than `end` (windows cannot cross midnight); `00:00`–`00:00` means the whole day.

end.description: Window end, `HH:MM`, inclusive (`23:59` lasts to midnight).

repeat.description: Days of the week the window applies on: `0` = Sunday … `6` = Saturday. Empty means every day.

cal_id.description: Service calendar ID from `POST /calendar/list` (for example `cal.xxxx`). When set, the window applies only on the calendar's workdays or days off, as chosen by `is_off`.

is_off.description: Used with `cal_id`: `true` applies the window only on the calendar's days off, `false` only on its workdays.

TryLinkPersonRequest.description: Parameters for attempting automatic IM account linking.

integration_id.description: IM integration ID; obtain it from `POST /datasource/im/war-room-enabled/list`.

TryLinkPersonResponse.description: Result of one linking run for the integration.

new_linked_person_ids.description: Person IDs linked to the IM app during this call. Empty when nobody was newly linked.

unmatched_count.description: Members with an email or phone that were looked up but not newly linked: not found on the IM platform, the IM account is already linked to another member, or the lookup failed for them.

no_contact_count.description: Unlinked members skipped because they have neither an email nor a phone number.

UnackIncidentRequest.description: Parameters for removing acknowledgement from one or more incidents.

incident_ids.description: Incident IDs to unacknowledge. At most 100 per call.

account_id.description: ID of the account the rule belongs to.

channel_id.description: ID of the channel the rule belongs to.

filters.description: Alert event conditions (OR of AND groups); matching events are discarded entirely. Empty means the rule matches nothing; `null` when the last update omitted `filters`.

status.description: Rule status: `enabled` or `disabled`; deleted rules never appear in the list.

rule_id.description: Rule ID (MongoDB ObjectID).

updated_by.description: ID of the user who last updated the rule.

created_at.description: Creation time, Unix timestamp in seconds.

updated_at.description: Last update time, Unix timestamp in seconds.

deleted_at.description: Deletion time, Unix timestamp in seconds. Omitted unless the rule is soft-deleted; deleted rules are excluded from list responses.

UpdateChannelRequest.description: Parameters for updating a channel. Only the fields you pass are updated.

channel_id.description: ID of the channel to update; obtain it from `POST /channel/list`.

team_id.description: New owning team ID; obtain it from `POST /team/list`. Must exist. Omit or pass `null` to keep the current team.

managing_team_ids.description: Replaces the additional managing teams, up to 3; every ID must exist. Pass `[]` to remove them all; omit to keep the current list.

channel_name.description: New channel name, 1–59 characters, unique within the account. Omit or pass `null` to keep the current name.

auto_resolve_timeout.description: Auto-resolve timeout in seconds. 0 disables auto-resolve. Max 30 days.

auto_resolve_mode.description: How the auto-resolve timer runs: `trigger` starts it once when the incident is triggered, `update` restarts it whenever a new alert merges in. Applied only together with `auto_resolve_timeout`; if `auto_resolve_timeout` is sent without it, the mode resets to `trigger`.

is_private.description: When true, the channel is visible only to its managing teams.

group.description: Alert grouping configuration; replaces the stored configuration as a whole when present.

flapping.description: Flapping detection configuration; replaces the stored configuration as a whole when present.

is_external_report_enabled.description: `true` enables external reporting and generates a new token, returned in the response (any previous token stops working); `false` disables it and clears the token.

event_group.description: Alert event merge configuration; replaces the stored configuration as a whole when present.

UpdateChannelResponse.description: Contains `external_report_token` only when the request set `is_external_report_enabled` to `true`; otherwise `data` is an empty object.

external_report_token.description: Newly generated token for external reporters; the previous token stops working. It can be read again later from `external_report_token` in `POST /channel/info`.

UpdateDropRuleRequest.description: Parameters for updating a channel drop rule.

channel_id.description: Owning channel ID; obtain it from `POST /channel/list`.

rule_id.description: Drop rule ID (MongoDB ObjectID).

description.description: Rule description, up to 500 characters. Omitting it clears the stored description.

filters.description: Alert event conditions (OR of AND groups); matching events are discarded entirely. Keys: `title`, `description`, `severity` (alias `alert_severity`, `event_severity`), `status`, `alert_key`, `title_rule`, `integration_id` (alias `data_source_id`), or any `labels.<name>`. The stored conditions are replaced; omitting this field clears them and the rule then matches nothing.

UpdateEscalationRuleRequest.description: Parameters for updating an escalation rule.

channel_id.description: Owning channel ID; obtain it from `POST /channel/list`.

rule_id.description: Escalation rule ID (MongoDB ObjectID).

priority.description: Evaluation order; lower values are evaluated first. Omit or pass `null` to keep the current value.

aggr_window.description: Delay in seconds before the first notification for a newly assigned incident; `0` notifies immediately. Omitting it resets the value to `0`.

template_id.description: Notification template ID (24-character hex); obtain it from `POST /template/list`. Must exist.

description.description: Rule description, up to 500 characters. Omitting it clears the stored description.

layers.description: Escalation levels in order. At least one level is required.

time_filters.description: Recurring time windows during which the rule can match. Replaces the stored windows; omit or leave empty to match at any time.

filters.description: Incident conditions (OR of AND groups), matched against the incident the alert was grouped into, not against the alert. Keys: `title`, `description`, `severity` (alias `incident_severity`, `alert_severity`), `status` (alias `incident_status`, `alert_status`), `dedup_key`, `integration_id` (alias `data_source_id`), or any `labels.<name>`. Replaces the stored conditions; omit or leave empty to match every incident in the channel.

display_name.description: New display name (max 39 characters); must stay unique among non-deleted fields. Always written.

description.description: New description. Always written: omitting it clears the description.

options.description: Replacement options list. Must obey the same per-type rules as create. Note: the update always overwrites `display_name`, `description`, `options`, and `default_value` with the submitted values, so for `single_select`/`multi_select` fields a non-empty `options` list must be sent on every update.

default_value.description: New default value; its type must match the field's `field_type`. Always written: omitting it clears the default.

UpdateIncidentCommentTypeRequest.description: Parameters for updating a comment type. Partial update: at least one of `name` or `color` must be provided.

comment_type_id.description: ID of the comment type to update (24-character hex ObjectID).

name.description: New display name. Trimmed before storing; must be unique within the account (case-insensitive). At most 40 characters. Must not contain control or text-direction characters.

color.description: New label color as a hex value in #RRGGBB format. Normalized to uppercase.

UpdateIncidentFieldsRequest.description: Fields to update on an incident. At least one field besides `incident_id` must be non-empty; omitted or empty fields keep their current values.

UpdateInhibitRuleRequest.description: Parameters for updating an inhibit rule.

channel_id.description: Owning channel ID; obtain it from `POST /channel/list`.

rule_id.description: Inhibit rule ID (MongoDB ObjectID).

description.description: Rule description, up to 500 characters. Omitting it clears the stored description.

equals.description: Keys whose values must be equal on the source alert and the incoming event. Only `title`, `severity` and `labels.<name>` take effect; any other key (for example `data_source_id`) is accepted but makes the rule never fire. Must be present; an empty array also makes the rule inert.

source_filters.description: Conditions the source (inhibiting) alert must match, evaluated against active alerts already stored in the channel. Keys: `title`, `description`, `severity` (alias `incident_severity`, `alert_severity`), `status` (alias `incident_status`, `alert_status`), or any `labels.<name>`. Empty makes the rule inert. Omitting it clears the stored conditions.

target_filters.description: Conditions the incoming target alert event must match to be inhibited; empty means every incoming event is a target. Keys: `title`, `description`, `severity` (alias `alert_severity`, `event_severity`), `status`, `alert_key`, `title_rule`, `integration_id` (alias `data_source_id`), or any `labels.<name>`. Omitting it clears the stored conditions.

is_directly_discard.description: When true, matching alert events are discarded entirely; when false, alerts are still recorded but marked as muted by this rule. Omitting it sets it to `false`.

UpdateRemoteConfigRequest.description: Publish a whole new remote configuration version. The client sends the complete object, not a patch: rule order carries meaning.

application_id.description: RUM application ID. Get application IDs via `POST /rum/application/list`.

reason.description: Optional free-text note (not an enum) on why this version was published, at most 255 characters; stored verbatim and returned as `reason` by `POST /rum/application/remote-config/history/list`.

UpdateRemoteConfigResponse.description: Version allocated to the published configuration.

version.description: Version number allocated to the published configuration (previous highest version + 1).

UpdateSilenceRuleRequest.description: Parameters for updating a silence rule. Exactly one of `time_filter` or `time_filters` must be provided, and `filters` must be non-empty.

channel_id.description: Owning channel ID; obtain it from `POST /channel/list`.

rule_id.description: Silence rule ID (MongoDB ObjectID).

description.description: Rule description, up to 500 characters. Omitting it clears the stored description.

time_filters.description: Recurring time windows. Mutually exclusive with `time_filter`.

time_filter.description: One-off silence window. Mutually exclusive with `time_filters`; exactly one of the two must be set.

filters.description: Alert event conditions (OR of AND groups); matching events are silenced while the time window is active. Required, with at least one condition. Keys: `title`, `description`, `severity` (alias `alert_severity`, `event_severity`), `status`, `alert_key`, `title_rule`, `integration_id` (alias `data_source_id`), or any `labels.<name>`.

is_directly_discard.description: When true, matching alert events are discarded entirely; when false, alerts are still recorded but marked as silenced by this rule. Omitting it sets it to `false`.

is_auto_delete.description: When true, a rule with a one-off `time_filter` is permanently removed about 24 hours after `end_time` (or after its last update, whichever is later). Rules created with `from_incident_id` are cleaned up the same way. Rules with recurring `time_filters` are never removed automatically. Omitting it sets it to `false`.

UpdateStatusPageChangeRequest.description: Parameters for updating the editable fields of a status page event.

page_id.description: Status page ID; obtain it from `GET /status-page/list`.
